question: Should v0.7.11 now be published as the superseding release after a release owner verifies the generated macOS archives are notarized and match the stated v0.7.10 content?
rationale: The code diff is release metadata only; whether the external pipeline outputs are complete and appropriate to publish is a release-owner decision that source review and checks alone cannot establish.

options.title: Verify then publish
options.body: Confirm the official pipeline's v0.7.11 macOS assets are signed and notarized before merging and publishing the superseding release.

options.title: Hold the release
options.body: Keep the PR open until the release pipeline or its asset provenance can be independently confirmed.

recommendation.title: Verify then publish
recommendation.body: Confirm the official pipeline's v0.7.11 macOS assets are signed and notarized before merging and publishing the superseding release.

likelyOwner.reason: This collaborator authored the release-preparation commit and is the only evidenced contact for the stated release pipeline.
